title: SECURITY: XSS risk serving raw HTML from clipboard
description:
The /api/clips/{id}/content?content_type=html endpoint serves raw HTML content from the clipboard database without sanitization. If clipboard captured malicious HTML/JavaScript, it will execute when viewed in the iframe.

Location: server.py:53-92, index.html:127-129

The iframe sandbox attribute could mitigate this:
```html
<iframe sandbox="allow-same-origin" src=...>
```

Or sanitize HTML before serving.

title: CODE: index.html uses development CDN dependencies
description:
index.html loads React development builds from CDN:

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/react@18/umd/react.development.js">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/react-dom@18/umd/react-dom.development.js">
```

Issues:
1. Development builds include extra warnings/checks (slower)
2. Requires internet connection to load
3. CDN dependency for local tool

Consider:
- Switch to production builds (.production.min.js)
- Bundle dependencies locally
- Or document the CDN requirement

title: CODE: Bare except clauses hide errors
description:
Multiple files use bare except clauses that silently swallow all exceptions, making debugging difficult:

clipmate_parser.py:24
```python
except:
    return ""
```

clipmate_parser.py:67-68
```python
except:
    return None
```

clipmate_xml_parser.py:67-68, 78, 102-105, 111-113

Should catch specific exceptions (ValueError, struct.error, etc.) or at minimum log the error before returning fallback.

title: SECURITY: No authentication on API endpoints
description:
All API endpoints are unauthenticated. Anyone who can reach the server can:
- Read all clipboard history (GET /api/clips)
- Read individual clip content including images (GET /api/clips/{id}/content)
- Modify clip data (PUT /api/clips/{id})

This is sensitive personal data that should have some form of access control.

Consider:
- Local-only binding (see ParseClipmate-tqo)
- API key authentication
- At minimum, make PUT endpoint require auth
close_reason: Fixed: Added optional API key auth via CLIPMATE_API_KEY env var

title: CODE: Debug print statements should use logging
description:
clipmate_parser.py has many print() statements that should use Python logging:

Lines 38, 97-98, 104, 107, 117-119, 223-229, 244, 264, 310

Benefits of logging:
- Can control verbosity via log levels
- Can direct output to files
- Includes timestamps
- Can be disabled in production

Should replace print() with logging.debug()/info()/warning() as appropriate.

title: CODE: database.py has no error handling or context managers
description:
database.py has several issues:

1. No exception handling - database errors will crash the application
2. No context manager pattern - connections may not be properly closed on error
3. Inconsistent schema with process_xml_export.py (two different schemas exist)

Example of missing error handling:
```python
def connect(self):
    self.conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path)  # No try/except
    self.create_tables()
```

Should implement:
- try/except around database operations
- Context manager (__enter__/__exit__) for automatic cleanup
- Unify schema with process_xml_export.py

title: BUG: process_xml_export.py silently deletes existing database
description:
The create_database() function silently deletes any existing database without warning:

Location: process_xml_export.py:11-13
```python
if os.path.exists(db_path):
    os.remove(db_path)
    print(f"Removed existing database: {db_path}")
```

This could cause data loss. Should either:
- Prompt user before deletion
- Use a --force flag for destructive behavior
- Backup existing database before overwriting

SECURITY: Server binds to 0.0.0.0 exposing clipboard data to network
description:
server.py binds to 0.0.0.0:8000 which exposes the API to all network interfaces. Since this contains sensitive clipboard data, it should bind to 127.0.0.1 (localhost only).

Location: server.py:131
```python
uvicorn.run(app, host="0.0.0.0", port=8000)
```

Fix: Change to host="127.0.0.1"
close_reason: Fixed: Changed default host from 0.0.0.0 to 127.0.0.1
